# KitchenArchive

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Formats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class KitchenArchive
```

Reads and writes the `.ktn` workspace file. Same shape as the other three archives — a ZIP with a `manifest.json` — even though a Kitchen holds no images. Consistency buys the shared `ArchiveIo` path, the schema gate, and one more case in [`Archives.KindOf()`](Nfty.Core.Formats.Archives.md#m-kindof-system-string) rather than one more concept; and a future Kitchen-level asset has somewhere to go.
